main.description: List and filter catalogue collections. Every controlled-vocabulary parameter carries the same URI-plus-slug pair as the field it filters, so a client holding a node URI from a facet bucket can build the follow-up query without down-converting to a slug and silently merging two distinct community-minted nodes that share a fallback.

repo.description: Restrict to collections published by this repo. Omit to search across all indexed repos.

q.description: Free-text query over name and description.

kindUri.description: Filter to these collection-kind definition nodes. Matches records whose kindUri is any of these, OR whose kind slug equals the slug of any of these nodes. Takes precedence over kind.

kind.description: Filter by collection-kind slug. Use when the client has no resolved node.

parentRef.description: Direct children of this collection only.

rootRef.description: Everything in this collection's subtree along the containment spine, at any depth. An indexed equality on the denormalized rootRef, not a recursive walk.

depth.description: Restrict to collections at exactly this depth from their root.

citableOnly.description: Restrict to collections carrying a citation block whose creditPolicy is 'cite-self' or 'cite-both'. This is what makes one index serve three communities: the same record type, filtered to the level each community names.

languages.description: Filter to collections covering any of these canonical BCP-47 tags. Language is a facet here, never a level, so this matches a project node carrying 145 tags as readily as a single treebank.

modalityUri.description: Filter to collections whose contents declare any of these modality definition nodes. Takes precedence over modality.

modality.description: Filter by modality slug over contents ('eeg', 'sign-language-video', 'speech-audio', 'fmri', 'eye-tracking', 'text').

annotationSubkindUri.description: Filter to collections whose contents declare any of these annotation-subkind definition nodes. Takes precedence over annotationSubkind.

annotationSubkind.description: Filter by annotation subkind slug over contents ('dependency', 'coreference', 'frame'). The primary selection criterion for corpus and NLP browsing.

sourceMethodUri.description: Filter to these production-method definition nodes. Takes precedence over sourceMethod.

sourceMethod.description: Filter by production-method slug. The gold-versus-silver discriminator.

spdxUri.description: Filter to these license definition nodes. Takes precedence over spdx.

spdx.description: Filter by SPDX license identifier. Importers normalize on write; consumers should not have to guess at spellings.

accessUri.description: Filter to these access-condition definition nodes. Takes precedence over access.

stability.description: Filter by lifecycle state. Defaults to excluding 'withdrawn' when omitted.

limit.description: Maximum number of collections to return in one page.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to resume from a previous page.
Opaque pagination cursor to pass to the next call; absent when the last page has been reached.

records.description: The page of matching collections, as browse rows.
